title: MONSTER V4 Step 3 — Universal Frozen Artifact Registry
scope: Create a separate authoritative registry ref that pins frozen MONSTER artifacts by exact Git blob SHA. Enforce the registry in permanent DevSystem CI. A protected blob may change only with an exact-head, exact-from/to thaw grant written to the external registry ref.
proof_policy: Freeze only after exact PR-head DevSystem targeted CI + devsystem-final-gate GREEN, merge, exact merged-main full certification + devsystem-final-gate GREEN, add Step 3 artifacts to authoritative registry, verify registry state, and release distributed lease.
